cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our message to the stallholders needs to be calm and accurate: the fair is going ahead. Please remove the word 'panic'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You panicked about the forecast and told them to cancel their vans.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The forecast has improved. Put that first. I'll ring the transport firms; please don't turn the update into a discussion of my tone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Two vans are cancelled. They need to know who's replacing them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the two names; I'll arrange replacements. Write 'transport being reorganised', please. Leave my earlier calls out of the update.
